# Sanskar Mittal

> Sanskar Mittal is a finance and accounts professional with 8+ years of experience in bookkeeping, month-end close, accounts receivable and payable, MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting and financial modeling for SaaS, service, eCommerce and product businesses. He is a Partner at Renocrew Solutions and a QuickBooks ProAdvisor, and works with clients on Upwork (100% Job Success). Based in Dhanbad, India; works remotely with clients worldwide.

Website: https://www.sanskarmittal.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanskar-mittal-a68703305/
Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~0109e40da226200e43
Book a call: https://www.sanskarmittal.com/#contact

## Services

- Bookkeeping & Month-End Close: Day-to-day bookkeeping, bank and credit card reconciliations, and a month-end close that's accurate, compliant and on time.
- Accounts Receivable & Payable: AR cleanups, collections follow-up and AP processes that keep cash coming in and bills paid on schedule.
- eCommerce Reconciliation: Amazon and Shopify sales through A2X, and Stripe and PayPal payouts reconciled to the bank, including full-year catch-ups for books that were never kept.
- Budgeting, Forecasting & FP&A: Budgets aligned to strategic goals, forecasting models and financial models in Excel, from startups to a company with a turnover of ₹75 crore+.
- MIS Reporting: Monthly MIS packs covering cash flow, profit and loss and the balance sheet, by cost centre where you need it, with ratio analysis.
- Migrations & Virtual CFO: Moving books between systems, such as Zoho to QuickBooks, plus cash flow management and advisory for growing businesses.

## Platforms and Tools

- Accounting Software: QuickBooks Online, Xero, Oracle NetSuite, Zoho Books, Tally, SAP, Accounting Seed, Yardi.
- eCommerce & Payments: Amazon, Shopify, A2X, Stripe, PayPal.
- Reporting & Operations: Microsoft Excel data models, Complex Excel queries, PowerPoint, Gusto, Clockify, Slack.
- Industries: SaaS, Service Businesses, eCommerce, Product Businesses, Startups.

## Experience

- Aug 2018 – May 2021: Executive, Aduki & Smriti Co.. Bookkeeping, monthly closes and financial statements; MIS reporting by cost centre; budgeting for a company with a turnover of ₹75 crore+; financial and ratio analysis.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Which accounting software do you work in?

QuickBooks Online (I'm a QuickBooks ProAdvisor), Xero, Oracle NetSuite, Zoho Books, Tally, SAP, Accounting Seed and Yardi, with reporting and models built in Microsoft Excel.

### Can you catch up books that were never kept?

Yes. I've reconciled a full year of an eCommerce business's books from scratch, and AR cleanups and catch-ups are a regular part of my work.

### Do you work with eCommerce sellers?

Yes. I reconcile Amazon and Shopify sales through A2X, and Stripe and PayPal payouts to the bank.

### What does your FP&A and virtual CFO support include?

Budgets aligned to your goals, forecasting and financial models, monthly MIS reports on cash flow, profit and loss and the balance sheet, and cash flow management and advice.

### Where are you based, and do you work remotely?

I'm based in Dhanbad, India (IST, UTC+5:30) and work remotely with clients worldwide, over video calls and inside your own accounting systems.

### How do we get started?

Book a free call from this page and walk me through your books and what you need. We'll agree on the next step on the call.
